[{"trigger_name":"set_coach_profiles_updated_at","enabled":"O","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER set_coach_profiles_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.coach_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_updated_at()","function_name":"handle_updated_at","function_definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'\nAS $function$\r\nBEGIN\r\n  NEW.updated_at = TIMEZONE('utc'::text, NOW());\r\n  RETURN NEW;\r\nEND;\r\n$function$\n"},{"trigger_name":"trigger_auto_create_coach_wallet","enabled":"O","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER trigger_auto_create_coach_wallet AFTER UPDATE ON public.coach_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION auto_create_coach_wallet()","function_name":"auto_create_coach_wallet","function_definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_create_coach_wallet()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'\nAS $function$\r\nBEGIN\r\n  IF NEW.status = 'approved' AND (OLD.status IS NULL OR OLD.status != 'approved') THEN\r\n    INSERT INTO public.wallets (coach_id, currency)\r\n    VALUES (NEW.id, 'EUR')\r\n    ON CONFLICT (coach_id) DO NOTHING;\r\n  END IF;\r\n  RETURN NEW;\r\nEND;\r\n$function$\n"}]
